sloka: प्रशान्तं च जगत्सर्वं सहस्राक्षे प्रतिष्ठिते ।यज्ञं चाद्भुतसङ्काशं तदा शक्रो ऽभ्यपूजयत् ।। ७.८६.१९ ॥
transliteration: praśāntaṁ ca jagatsarvaṁ sahasrākṣe pratiṣṭhite ।yajñaṁ cādbhutasaṅkāśaṁ tadā śakro 'bhyapūjayat ।। 7.86.19 ॥

translations.english: And when the thousand-eyed Indra was re-established, the entire world became peaceful, and then Indra worshipped the wondrous sacrifice.
